lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Good afternoon, na Chidi I be, calling from Kolanut Credit. Abeg, I fit speak with Mr. Emeka Okafor?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Oga Emeka, your loan of ₦85,000 don pass due date by twelve days. The balance now with penalty na ₦97,400.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Ah, I know say I owe. But my brother, I lost my work since March, things hard well well. I dey try.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Everybody dey talk say things hard. If you no pay this one by 6pm today, we go send your name and picture to everybody for your contact list say you be debtor.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Abeg no do that, my oga for work go see am.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Then make you pay. I fit even report you to police, dem go come carry you from your house.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Police? For loan? I no fit pay everything today, abeg.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Okay, see, make I help you. We get top-up loan of ₦150,000, you fit collect am today, clear this one, and the rest go help you for house.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Another loan? Hmm. How much be the interest?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: No worry about interest now, just accept am for the app before 6pm.
